# C09 — Speed and autonomy

**Depth:** byproduct (telemetry)

`benchmark/alert_pipeline.py` turns alerts into ready cases through the same `Runner` as the one command, so a pre-investigation carries identical attested evidence, proof and recorded I/O. p95 latency and cost per case are reported per run (`eval/reports/run_summary.md`, `pipeline.md`).

**Attested:** The pre-investigation is the same code path and the same attestations as a run by hand.

**Numbers:** `eval/reports/run_summary.md`, `pipeline.md` (generated by the run, never typed here).

**Reproduce:** `make pipeline`
